drugIndex.intro: Look up a medicine by name, or start from a symptom to find over-the-counter options — all from offline FDA drug labels.
drugIndex.emptyText: Download the openFDA drug-label dataset to enable offline search. Requires ~1.7 GB compressed download (~8–10 GB after ingestion).
drugIndex.confirmRestartIngest: Restart the ingest? This clears the current (possibly stuck) ingest job and re-runs it from the already-downloaded files.

search.placeholder: Search a medicine by name — ibuprofen, Benadryl, loratadine…
search.hint: Type a medicine name above to search {{total}} FDA drug labels.
search.tryTab: Looking for something to treat a symptom instead? Try the <tabLink>By situation</tabLink> tab.

situation.emptyHint: Pick a situation (or a few) above to see the over-the-counter drugs whose FDA labels list it.
situation.noneTreatsAll: No single option treats all {{selected}} of these — here are options for each situation.
situation.noAdditional: No additional OTC options found for <bold>{{label}}</bold>.

fdaTab.title: FDA drug data
fdaTab.installed: {{total}} drug labels installed. Updating re-checks openFDA for a newer dataset and refreshes the offline copy.

drugIndex.footerNote: Label data and situation matches are label-text only; do not rely on them for medical decisions.

interactions.title: Compare label warnings
interactions.intro: View each drug's FDA-labeled interaction warnings side by side. Select up to {{max}} drugs.
interactions.disclaimer: <bold>This shows each drug's own FDA-labeled interaction warnings, individually.</bold> It is <bold>not</bold> a cross-drug interaction checker and is <bold>not</bold> a substitute for professional medical review. Absence of text here does not mean a drug is safe to combine.
interactions.emptyText: Download the openFDA drug-label dataset to enable offline search and comparison.
interactions.goToDownload: Go to Drug Reference to download data
interactions.searchPlaceholder: Search for a drug to add…
interactions.selectHint: Select drugs above to compare their labeled interaction warnings.
interactions.footerNote: Label data is provided as-is; do not rely on it for medical decisions.

interactionColumn.noText: No labeled interaction text on this label.

sections.interactionsFootnote: Single-drug label information — not a cross-drug interaction checker

show.disclaimer: Do not rely on this data to make decisions regarding medical care. While every effort is made to ensure accuracy, you should assume all results are unvalidated.

disclaimerModal.title: Before you use the Drug Reference
disclaimerModal.intro: This tool shows general health information from official <bold>FDA drug labels</bold> and matches symptoms to over-the-counter options. It is provided for <bold>information only</bold>.
disclaimerModal.notAdvice: It is <bold>not medical advice</bold> and not a substitute for a doctor, pharmacist, or nurse.
disclaimerModal.notChecker: It is <bold>not a drug-interaction checker</bold>. Always read each product’s full label and check with a professional before combining medicines.
disclaimerModal.matches: Situation matches come from label text, not clinical recommendations — they can be incomplete or include products you wouldn’t expect.
disclaimerModal.followProduct: Always follow the directions on the <bold>actual product you have</bold>; dosages and warnings differ between products.
disclaimerModal.emergency: In an emergency, or if symptoms are severe, worsening, or you’re unsure, <bold>contact a medical professional or call emergency services</bold>.
disclaimerModal.dataNote: Data is from openFDA (U.S. FDA, public domain). NOMAD is not affiliated with or endorsed by the FDA.

download.failed: The download failed — it retries automatically; if it stays failed, press "Download FDA data" to restart. Finished parts are kept and resume where they left off.
download.completed: All parts are on disk. Indexing them into search next.
download.runningParts: Pulling part {{part}} of {{total}} — ~1.7 GB total across all parts.

ingest.failed: Indexing failed — press "Ingest into search" to retry from the downloaded files (no re-download). Already-indexed labels are kept (the refresh is idempotent).
ingest.runningParts: Writing part {{part}} of {{total}} into the offline database.
ingest.running: Writing labels into the offline database.

ingestStatus.background: Runs in the background — you can leave this page and it keeps going. Search turns on automatically when ingest finishes.

conditions.noDrugDataText: Download the offline FDA drug labels from Drug Reference to see matches for this situation.
conditions.noMatches: No over-the-counter drugs match “{{label}}” in the current label data. Try searching by drug name in <link>Drug Reference</link>.
conditions.remedySources: Sources: NCCIH “Herbs at a Glance” (NIH) and US-government health guidance (CDC, MedlinePlus/NLM, FDA). Public domain (US government works).
conditions.footerNote: Matches are FDA label-indication text, not medical recommendations. Do not rely on this data to make decisions regarding medical care.

safetyBanner.title: Informational reference only — not medical advice.
safetyBanner.notRecommendation: These results match FDA drug-label indications to a situation. They are <bold>not a recommendation</bold> and <bold>not an FDA endorsement</bold>.
safetyBanner.notChecker: This is <bold>not a drug-interaction checker</bold>. Read each label’s full warnings, and check with a pharmacist or clinician before combining medicines.
safetyBanner.emergency: In an emergency, or if symptoms are severe or worsening, <bold>contact a medical professional or call emergency services</bold>.

remedySafetyNote.title: Informational only — not medical advice.
remedySafetyNote.body: These remedies have limited or mixed evidence, are not FDA-evaluated, and are not a substitute for professional care. Check with a clinician before using any of them, and before combining one with a medication you already take.
remedySafetyNote.emergency: In an emergency, or if symptoms are severe or worsening, <bold>seek real medical care — call emergency services</bold>.
